notes: Added DONE and NOT DONE subfolders beneath every manufacturer folder in 01 — WEAPONS.

Exactly 16 approved weapons are treated as finished and Market-ready: Breachhound, Crusher, Hexburst, Igla, Lexington, Liberty, Overture, Saratoga, Tactician, Umbra, Unity, Warwake, Ashura, Dian, Kyokokukamusari, and Masamune.
The 12 approved Bastion weapons remain under Bastion and the 4 approved Corvus weapons remain under Corvus, now inside each manufacturer's DONE folder.
Every other weapon and variant in the curated weapon tree is moved to its parent manufacturer's NOT DONE folder.
NOT DONE weapons are changed to sourceCategory=Weapons_Unfinished, catalogEnabled=false, curatedCatalogV10=false, marketReady=false, and shopType=none so the existing Market cannot catalog them.
DONE weapons are normalized to sourceCategory=Weapons, catalogEnabled=true, curatedCatalogV10=true, marketReady=true, and shopType=arms.

Persistent Market stock is scrubbed of unfinished weapon IDs, and a live Market DOM guard prevents stale in-memory stock from displaying or purchasing unfinished weapons until the Market is freshly reloaded.
If the Market is open while the GM runs the loader, the current vendor stock is rerolled immediately against the new completion gate.
